_how_to_verify: Open the Menu screen -> DevTools -> Sources -> find menu.php (or the page's rendered HTML via Elements tab) -> read the <select id="MenuType">, <select id="MenuNature">, <select id="MenuStatus"> option values/labels directly. These are static HTML options, not a DB-driven picklist, so there is no SelectList endpoint to fetch them from live -- they must be read from the form once and set '_verified' to true below.
